messages:
mira: quick design review 16/keys UI. main items: revoke vs rotate affordances, modal ordering, empty-state language for non-admins, and a11y focus flow. dropping a couple of screenshots in the doc: https://redwood.design/keys-v2 

devon: Looked at screenshots. Concern: revoke modal currently shows Cancel as primary (blue) and Revoke as secondary. That's confusing and opposite of other destructive flows. propose: Revoke = red primary (right), Cancel = neutral (left).

tal: Agree on ordering. Also, the revoke confirmation text is long. Suggest trimming to one sentence + an expand link for details. Example: "This will immediately stop traffic using this key." then a link: "Why this matters".

mira: Good. For rotate, product asked for an in-place rotate (no name change). Engineering notes we need a staged operation. I'd like the UI to show a short progress state with bullet steps, but don't expose internal key IDs. Keep the labels user-friendly: "Creating replacement key", "Swapping bindings", "Cleaning up old key".

sam: UX: the progress modal should maintain focus inside while running. If user hits Esc before swap we allow cancel; after swap, disable cancel. Accessibility: screen reader should announce step changes. Use aria-live region for step text.

aria-bot: accessibility-scan: missing focus-return after modal close detected in /keys revoke and rotate flows. Also low contrast on permission badges (.role-badge). Recommend focus management and color adjustments.

devon: On empty state copy: we currently show "Get started". For clarity, switch to explicit action text: "Create an API key". If current user lacks permission, show disabled CTA with tooltip: "Admins only". We should also surface a small hint link: "Who can create keys?" that opens the org permissions doc.

tal: Bulk actions: to reduce accidental mass revokes, require a confirmation modal when selecting more than 3 keys (3 is conservative). The modal should require a checkbox: "I understand revoking will stop services using these keys." For org-admin role, require typing the org slug for extra safety.

mira: Good constraints. Also request a small UI tweak: add a subtle badge on keys that are attached to Dedicated pools: a small flame icon + tooltip "Dedicated assignment", and if revoking show an inline banner: "This key is bound to Dedicated XXXX and may cause immediate failures." with a short Toggle to "Show affected routes". Keep banner tone warning not alarmist.

sam: Button tone: Use consistent language: primary buttons use verb-first labels: "Revoke key", "Rotate key", "Create key". Avoid generic verbs like "Confirm" when context exists.

aria-bot: contrast warning: .role-badge text ratio 3.2:1 on light theme. Suggested replacements: #1f2937 or add 1px stroke. Also advise visible focus ring on keyboard tab for all action links.

devon: QA checklist additions: keyboard-only flow for rotate + revoke, focus landing after modal close (to the key list or empty CTA), screen reader announcement per step, and progressive disclosure links are reachable.

tal: Small copy for revoke modal proposed: 

Revoke API key
This will immediately stop any services using this key. If you need continuity, use Rotate instead.

Link: "Show services using this key"

mira: Perfect. I'll update the mocks: fix button ordering, shorten revoke copy, add progress modal with step labels and aria-live, add dedicated badge + banner, bump role-badge contrast, and update empty-state CTAs and bulk-action thresholds. Will re-request review when done. :sparkles:

sam: Thanks. Also add a note to the product playbook about hiding transient internal IDs during rotate so users see only final friendly names.

aria-bot: posted selectors in design doc comments: .role-badge, .modal-footer .primary, .bulk-confirm-input.

mira: closing now unless more feedback.
